subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the modular dashboard workspace stack as a bundled Control UI product direction, and under what storage and security boundaries?
rationale: The request adds a new bundled plugin, persistent dashboard state, Gateway RPC/event surfaces, agent tools, a native Control UI workspace, and untrusted browser widget execution; automation should not decide that product and security boundary.

options.title: Review and sponsor the stack
options.body: Proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101094, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101097, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101098 in order, requiring storage, security, upgrade, and proof fixes before merge.

options.title: Narrow to core seams first
options.body: Land only the generic plugin/API gaps maintainers want, and ask dashboard-specific widgets/workspaces to remain external until sponsored.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR stack if maintainers decide agent-composable dashboards are not current roadmap work.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101094, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101097, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101098 in order, requiring storage, security, upgrade, and proof fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged Control UI and plugin-tab seam history makes him the strongest available routing candidate for this product decision.
